---
title: "ocel env get"
description: "Inspect a value."
---

```bash
ocel env get <KEY> [flags]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Takes |
| --- | --- |
| `<KEY>` | Required |

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--environment` | `string` |  | Use this named preview environment; requires `--preview` |
| `--folder` | `string` |  | Use the value in this folder |
| `--preview` | `bool` | `false` | Use preview values |
| `--reveal` | `bool` | `false` | Print the value |
| `-y, --yes` | `bool` | `false` | Consent in advance to any confirmation this command would ask for |

Every command also takes the [global flags](/docs/cli#global-flags).

## Behaviour

- Read-only: it changes nothing.
- Asks before it changes anything: `--yes` consents in advance.
- Prints data on stdout. Under `--json` it prints one result envelope, whose JSON Schema `ocel schema env get` prints.
